items.period: Seal-script tradition; the file depicts a Shuowen seal-style form, without a specimen date
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 山 in Shuowen seal-script style, illustrating a later stylized form in the character's graphic history.
items.alt: A seal-script form of 山, drawn as a stylized set of rising peaks.
items.selection_reason: The Sinica graph-history record identifies 山 as a pictograph of mountain peaks and includes a small-seal stage; this file page provides an exact, reusable modern illustration of that stage.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, as stated on the exact Commons file page.

limitations.text: The image is a modern digital vector drawing, not a photograph or scan of an ancient inscription; the direct SVG was not visually rendered in this research.
The paleographic record lists oracle-bone, bronze, Chu manuscript, seal and Shuowen categories but supplies no specimen-by-specimen dates in its accessible text.
